description: GreenHyDE presents gas-network data and procedures for developing and assessing transition topologies from natural gas to hydrogen. The paper considers simultaneous supply-security needs during pipeline repurposing. The provider is Joachim Müller-Kirchenbauer and coauthors, TU Berlin. Coverage: The application concerns Germany’s transmission system and alternative transition scenarios. The paper was first published in May 2024; exact numerical resolution was not established here. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The version of record is published under CC BY-NC 4.0 and is free to read. Provider confirmation is required before reuse. Limitations: These are feasibility scenarios, not completed infrastructure changes. The linked data and tools were not executed or independently assessed. For simulation it supplies a documented application of linked network design and transition feasibility analysis. Related resources: data-scigrid-gas describes a separate European gas-network data family. No equivalence with the study database is assumed.
